description: Source code implementing a Vault class for secure key and data management, including import/export, creation, deletion, and handling of cryptographic keys with secure processor interactions.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Implements secure storage and management of cryptographic keys and data blobs, with support for import/export, creation, deletion, and resource management.

methods.name: Vault::Vault
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Vault, setting up secure processor handle.

methods.name: Vault::ProcessorRelease
methods.description: Explicitly releases the secure processor resource.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Returns size of the key/data blob for a given id, considering if sealed data is allowed.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Stores a key/data blob, provisioning cryptographic keys as needed, and returns an id.

methods.name: Vault::ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Loads a persistent key from a file into the vault, returning its id.

methods.name: Vault::CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks if a persistent key exists based on filename.

methods.name: Vault::CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new persistent AES/HMAC key with specified type and exportability.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports the sec object ids for a stored key/data blob.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores an encrypted data blob and returns its id.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a stored encrypted data blob by id.

methods.name: Vault::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key/data blob and associated cryptographic objects.
